title: The Fake Swoon
premise: She fakes a faint so he'll catch her — he catches her like a wooden plank.
hook: she planned the perfect fake faint for you 😳

clips.focus: tsundere rich girl, fake fall to be caught, awkward stiff catch, embarrassment, teasing, comedy of failure

arcs.girl: plotting and nervous at first, then cringing at herself, then theatrical fake swoon, then disbelief, then furious tomato-red blush
arcs.boy: calm and oblivious-looking, catches her like a stiff wooden plank with arms locked straight, then a knowing little smirk while pushing up his glasses

shots.title: THE STAKEOUT
shots.action: Medium close-up: the blonde girl peeks out from behind a stone pillar, smoothing her long hair, taking a deep breath, eyes darting.
shots.dialogue: Girl (whispering to herself): 「…いい？彼が来たら、か弱く倒れて…受け止めてもらうだけ。」
shots.sfx: soft footsteps echoing far away, fabric rustle

shots.title: SELF-CRINGE
shots.action: Close-up: she covers her burning red face with both hands and shakes her head.
shots.dialogue: Girl: 「…って、何やってるのよ私！」

shots.title: TARGET APPROACHES
shots.action: Wide shot: the boy with glasses walks down the sunlit corridor reading a book, unaware. The girl steps out and dramatically swoons toward him, back of her hand to her forehead.

shots.title: THE PLANK CATCH
shots.action: Medium two-shot: he catches her by both shoulders with arms locked perfectly straight, holding her at a full arm's length like a stiff board. Frozen awkward silence.
shots.sfx: awkward silence sting, a single crow caw

shots.title: HIS SMIRK
shots.action: Close-up: her face turns tomato red and she shoves his hands off; cut to him pushing up his round glasses with one finger, a tiny knowing smirk.
shots.dialogue: Girl (voice cracking): 「な、なんでもないわよ！」 Boy (calm, teasing): 「はいはい。足元、気をつけてね。」
shots.sfx: blush pop, glasses glint ting, music button
shots.camera: quick push-in, then slow push-in on him

clips.final_visual: he goes back to his book with a small smile while her blonde hair whips out of frame as she storms off.
clips.ending_mood: playful embarrassment — her plan failed, but she is not giving up.
